nodes.label: HM Visuals Portfolio
nodes.rationale: Full rebrand portfolio site for Hussain Marzooq (photographer/videographer/NFT artist/dance teacher/web developer), Dubai-based. Not yet deployed; hussain-marzooq.com still serves the old landing page.

nodes.label: Tech Stack
nodes.rationale: Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, MongoDB Atlas, Cloudinary, Resend. Deployed on Netlify, not Vercel. Three.js, react-globe.gl, GSAP, Framer Motion, Lenis, react-markdown.

nodes.label: Cloudinary Image Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Next's optimizer is bypassed via custom loader (lib/cloudinary-image-loader.ts); every next/image src rewritten to a Cloudinary delivery URL. The optimizer blew past its 7s fetch timeout re-encoding full originals, 500ing images. Never add 'unoptimized' to a Cloudinary next/image (the S6 bug).

nodes.label: Content Security Policy
nodes.rationale: Full CSP in next.config.ts, dev/prod aware. Narrow allowlist: Cloudinary img/media, upload widget frame, OpenStreetMap, YouTube/Vimeo/Instagram frame-src, gc.zgo.at + goatcounter for analytics. media-src added D4; frame-ancestors none. Any new external iframe/CDN needs a directive edit + in-browser check.

nodes.label: Admin Auth System
nodes.rationale: scrypt hash login (ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH); plaintext fallback deleted S1. HMAC-signed session cookie v1.<issuedAtMs>.<nonce> with 2-day server-enforced TTL. Auth constants in one place: lib/auth/session-token.ts, runtime-agnostic because proxy.ts runs Edge. Compare secrets constant-time.

nodes.label: Design Direction Spec
nodes.rationale: The design is measured from the code, not invented. No DESIGN.md (DS2 declined a second source of truth). Achromatic palette, all colour from the work; no brand accent, no eyebrows/kickers, no stat strips, no gradients, no scroll-jacking, no sound, no generic overlay transitions.

nodes.label: Button component
nodes.rationale: The only public button (components/shared/Button.tsx). One geometry (.hm-btn), two looks: ghost (default) and solid, lifted from the hero pills, hard-coded white (dark-first). No arrow, no three-variant system — Hussain rejected both. The border shorthand must NOT be in .hm-btn.

nodes.label: PageHeader component
nodes.rationale: All public page headers. No eyebrow prop — removed sitewide in N4, ban is broader than the prop.

nodes.label: PortfolioCard component
nodes.rationale: All full-bleed image cards with overlay. Not an <a> itself: div + absolute cover Link + pointer-events layering so chips/CTA don't nest anchors. Presentational since D4's global click interceptor.

nodes.label: AnimatedText component
nodes.rationale: All text reveals. Word-mode only, scroll-triggered. No char/line modes.

nodes.label: NoResults component
nodes.rationale: Shared empty-state panel (D13). Replaced five hand-rolled 'no results' divs.

nodes.label: lib/disciplines
nodes.rationale: Single source of the 5 canonical disciplines (D13): DISCIPLINES, DISCIPLINE_HREF, disciplineForCategory. Homepage marketing labels deliberately NOT sourced from here.

nodes.label: useMagneticHover hook
nodes.rationale: Shared magnetic-hover pull for CTAs (D8), via the independent CSS translate property. Applied only to nav Book (desktop) + StickyCta — not sitewide (blanket magnetism reads as gimmick).

nodes.label: useAdminAction hook
nodes.rationale: All admin loading/fetch/feedback flows (F5). Feedback must be accurate and specific (S11); multi-part saves report per-part via Promise.allSettled. D9b added opt-in auto-dismiss.

nodes.label: AdminButton component
nodes.rationale: The only admin button (D9). Variants default/solid/danger/warning/ghost, sizes xs/sm/md. Swept across every admin action button.

nodes.label: AdminSidebarNav component
nodes.rationale: Protected-layout sidebar (D9). Owns NAV_GROUPS, highlights active route. NAV_GROUPS later extracted to nav-groups.ts (A1).

nodes.label: AdminPageHeader component
nodes.rationale: Every protected admin surface's page header (D9b). Wraps flex-col sm:flex-row (A1) which fixed the services-page iOS auto-zoom.

nodes.label: AdminToggle component
nodes.rationale: Shared admin switch (D9b). Used by Pages-list visibility toggle and editor VisibilityGroup.

nodes.label: Admin bulk-select system
nodes.rationale: Reusable bulk-select (D9b): useBulkSelection, BulkCheckbox, BulkActionBar, runBulkAction. Wired into all 8 admin lists; no bulk API routes, loops single-item endpoints via Promise.allSettled.

nodes.label: useUnsavedChangesGuard hook
nodes.rationale: Shared unsaved-work guard (S11): beforeunload + capture-phase click interceptor confirming before internal-link nav while dirty.

nodes.label: useScrollLock hook
nodes.rationale: Shared overlay scroll-lock (D12): stops Lenis + sets documentElement overflow hidden while mounted.

nodes.label: lib/password-gate
nodes.rationale: Shared password-gate primitives (D12): scrypt hash/verify, makeAccessToken, HMAC person-gate cookie sign/verify. Rotate access token on password change to invalidate old cookies. Private-gallery gate keeps its own separate copy.

nodes.label: app/api/_lib/admin-route
nodes.rationale: Every admin [id] mutation route's preamble (S2b): requireAdminObjectId (auth-before-parse), findByIdOr404, wantsHardDelete.

nodes.label: MediaPickerModal + ImageField
nodes.rationale: All admin image pick/upload flows (N7). ImageField gained an optional folder prop (C1). Adopted CloudinaryUploadButton in A1.

nodes.label: SortableList component
nodes.rationale: All admin drag-to-reorder (T1). Owns sensors + DndContext + SortableContext. Given a stable id={useId()} (D13) to fix a hydration mismatch — the earlier 'dnd-kit useId is hydration-safe' note was wrong.

nodes.label: useMediaSearch + MediaTagChips
nodes.rationale: All media search/filter surfaces (D3). useMediaSearch takes an optional lockedTag scoping search to one tag (tag subpages).

nodes.label: TagChipRow component
nodes.rationale: All tag-subpage navigation (T2). Compact boxed sideways-scrolling chip row of Links, Lenis-safe. Distinct from MediaTagChips (in-place filter).

nodes.label: AppShell component
nodes.rationale: Holds every global element (N9): Lenis, Navbar, Preloader, grain overlay, CustomCursor, SiteFooter, TransitionProvider, SiteAnalytics — all behind if (isAdmin) return gate, so none render on /admin/*. Footer passed as prop from layout.tsx (server component via client parent).

nodes.label: Page transition system
nodes.rationale: ONE site-wide contact-sheet gallery transition on every internal nav (D4). Six bespoke per-route transitions were built, rejected on sight, reverted. TransitionProvider installs a document capture-phase click interceptor. Image pool is a single server pool (getTransitionImages), fail-safe to []; fade guard when pool has <2 distinct photos (P1).

nodes.label: Exhibition Globe
nodes.rationale: HomeExhibitionGlobe (D6): react-globe.gl directly under the hero, ranked city index + globe. Reads getExhibitionCities. Two overrides at Hussain's request: arcs from Dubai + brighter earth-day.jpg. Textures in /public/globe served same-origin (never point globeImageUrl at a CDN — CSP blocks it, ships as black ball).

nodes.label: HomeHero + HeroBokeh
nodes.rationale: The hero is fixed — not to be redesigned (Hussain, 2026-08-17), bug fixes only. HeroBokeh is a 180-point Three.js shader system statically imported by HomeHero, so three is in the homepage initial bundle (~140-160KB gzip).

nodes.label: WorkOverlay component
nodes.rationale: Full-screen Work nav overlay with the 5 discipline cards. Motion rebuilt D13: symmetric front-facing arc + sine sway (matching the photography cylinder isFew branch), never a full-spin cylinder — few cards on a full circle left empty gaps. Keeps bg-black/92 (full-screen takeover).

nodes.label: MediaLightbox component
nodes.rationale: Renders through createPortal(document.body) at z-[120] to escape AppShell's z-10 stacking context (the D12 footer-covering bug), + useScrollLock + Escape-to-close. Refactored onto ModalPortal in P2.

nodes.label: ModalPortal component
nodes.rationale: Shared portal-to-body + useScrollLock + Escape (P2). Fixed the content-modal footer/scroll-behind bug site-wide across all six content modals. WorkOverlay stays separate (top-level GSAP takeover).

nodes.label: People Privacy System
nodes.rationale: Three visibility states (D12): Public, Password-protected (hidden from index, gated), Hidden (404). State machine getPersonPageBySlug (missing|locked|unavailable|open). Removal flow with required email+message, inline password-set on approve, audit in removal_requests. Media linked to a gated person is forced non-public.

nodes.label: Page content CMS
nodes.rationale: Three collections one surface (/admin/pages): page_settings (visibility), page_seo (5 SEO+header fields), page_sections (panel/card content). Since D9b per-page routes not modals. Empty means empty everywhere — no auto-pick. Revalidate the layout not enumerate routes (S9).

nodes.label: Tag Taxonomy (media_tags)
nodes.rationale: media.tags is a validated slug array from the media_tags taxonomy (T1). Per-tag disciplines[] field removed T2 — a tag earns a subpage from media presence. Reserved slug 'videos'. Rename cascades, delete blocked while referenced unless ?detach=1.

nodes.label: Open Graph Images
nodes.rationale: Admin-driven page_seo.ogImageUrl through one shared buildPublicMetadata (lib/seo/page-metadata.ts) across all 16 public blocks + one branded next/og fallback card (C2). Omits images key when no image so the file fallback merges. metadataBase from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.

nodes.label: GoatCounter Analytics
nodes.rationale: GoatCounter (free, cookieless) chosen over Plausible (C3). SiteAnalytics one tag on public pages only (structural guarantee below AppShell isAdmin gate) + in-admin /admin/analytics reading GoatCounter API server-side via getGoatCounterStats. Two env vars; API token server-only, never NEXT_PUBLIC_.

nodes.label: Blog System
nodes.rationale: blog_posts + blog_categories, admin CRUD, public /blog + /blog/[slug] (C1). Markdown via react-markdown + remark-gfm to React elements — no dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Visibility toggle in Pages tab via toggleOnly row flag.

nodes.label: InstagramFeed + lib/instagram
nodes.rationale: Dancing page native Instagram embeds (D10). Auto-sizes each card via Instagram's MEASURE postMessage (origin-checked). The clip hack was rejected — you cannot reach into a cross-origin iframe. instagram.com added to frame-src.

nodes.label: WebProjectCard + lib/web-projects
nodes.rationale: Web-development page link-out cards (D11). Screenshots via same-origin proxy /api/web-projects/preview fetching thum.io server-side — no CSP change, no SSRF (only image.thum.io fetched). No image upload (rejected, reverted).

nodes.label: Media Locations (C4)
nodes.rationale: Validated location selector storing coordinates at save time (C4), no render-time geocode. Appearance is now one shared type. Appearance requires a name to save (D6). Admin-gated → sanitise-and-store, don't re-geocode. No backfill.

nodes.label: CustomCursor component
nodes.rationale: Cursor enhancements (D5): velocity stretch, ghost trail, spring overshoot, zone-reactive size, blend-difference. Desktop-only — bails unless (pointer: fine) (P2).

nodes.label: Preloader (D1)
nodes.rationale: GSAP icon sequence replaying on every arrival at / (no sessionStorage gate — Hussain's decision). Camera/Video/Bitcoin/dancing-emoji/Code2, then 'Art' glides right while 'Hussain.' assembles per-letter. Cormorant Garamond, preloader-only. Self-managed exit.

nodes.label: Photography 3-view Viewer
nodes.rationale: Cylinder/Horizontal/Grid on one shared filter (D3). Cylinder shallow arc ≤5, closed prism 6+. Horizontal marquee with drag+ping-pong (Hussain rejected a ScrollTrigger pin — 'the lock is ruining the user experience'). All three run on every breakpoint (reversed D3's mobile-Grid fallback).

nodes.label: Lenis smooth scroll
nodes.rationale: Initialized in AppShell (public only). Synced to ScrollTrigger via lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update) (D3). No scroll-jacking anywhere.
